paragraphs: [Bava Metzia 68a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Metzia.68a.3-4): Rav Ashi said, “The elders of Mata Mechasya told me.”[^1]

notes.text: Rav Ashi twice says that the elders of Mata Mechasya told him teachings about a mortgage. Hyman quotes the opening formula.
